ON THE 11 th OF JUNE, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 21154 of 2024  BETWEEN:-
 SURAJLAL BAIGA S/O SWAMILAL BAIGA, AGED ABOUT  22 YEARS, OCCUPATION: PRIVATE JOB RESIDENT OF  VILLAGE DEVGAWA POLICE STATION AND TAHSIL  PALI DISTRICT UMARIA (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI MADAN SINGH - ADVOCATE)
 AND  1. STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  S TATI ON PALI DISTRICT UMARIA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 2. VICTIM A S/O NOT MENTION THROUGH POLICE  STATION PALI, DISTRICT UMARIA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (SHRI NARENDRA LODHI - PANEL LAWYER FOR RESPONDENT NO.1)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER Case diary is perused.
Learned counsel for the rival parties are heard.
The applicant has filed this first application under Section 439 Cr.P.C for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 19.12.2023 by Police Station Pali, District Umaria (M.P.) in connection with Crime No. 626 of 2023 registered for 2 MCRC-21154-2024 offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 342, 506 of the IPC and Sections 5L, 6 of the POCSO Act.

sentences.text: The case of the prosecution in short is that on 20.11.2023 the applicant abducted the minor prosecutrix while she was going to her school near Village Devgawan and had taken her to Village Pongari in the house of her brother-in- law, thereafter, at Jabalpur where he committed rape with her in the house of his grandparents.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.
The applicant is in custody since 19.12.2023.
Charge-sheet has been filed in the matter.
The applicant is a permanent resident of Umaria and there is no likelihood of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
He is ready to abide by the terms and conditions as may be imposed.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for grant of bail is made out.
P er contra, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application but he fairly admits that there is no criminal antecedent found against the present applicant.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.
The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
A copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for information and compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.
